title: Settling the Arrears on a Crop Input Purchasing Account: the Figure Quoted and the Payment Taken
content:
Where a member asks what they must remit to bring the arrears on a crop input account back inside the cooperative's terms, the desk quotes one figure and the member pays it in their own name. The money posts against what they owe on the Crop Input Purchasing Accounts, and they see it on the account at once and on the next statement.

The figure that settles the arrears on a crop input account is fixed only once that account's ledger carries the service charge due on its overdue invoices for the statement month then running.

## Taking the payment

The payment is taken with `post_member_arrears_payment_ad47b93a`, which is the member's own tool: the desk unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it, so the line posts in the member's own name. One call posts a single payment line carrying the remittance reference the money is being sent under together with the route it is coming by, so the money can be matched when it lands.

### Parameters

- `account_id` — the internal reference number identifying the crop input account the money is being put onto; it is taken from the crop input account record pulled up for this member before the call.
- `payment_reference` — the remittance reference the money is being sent under, written in the shape PY- followed by six digits, for instance PY-901772, passed exactly in that shape with no spaces and no lower-case letters; there is no empty-value form.
- `payment_method` — the route the money is coming by, one of: `check`, a paper draft mailed or handed over; `ach`, an electronic bank transfer from the member's own account; `grain_settlement_transfer`, money out of the proceeds of grain the member has sold to the cooperative; `prepay_application`, money already held to the member's credit ahead of the season being drawn down onto the account; `credit_card`, payment at the counter or over the telephone by card; `patronage_credit`, money out of an equity or patronage disbursement standing to the member.
- `payment_amount` — the money the member is putting onto the account on this line, in USD to 2 decimal places, stated as a positive figure and rounded half away from zero to the cent at the moment of the call; there is no empty-value form and no currency symbol is passed.

### The return

A confirmation sentence in plain text, carrying the payment line's own internal reference, the remittance reference the money is coming under, the route it is coming by and the money in USD to two decimal places. That sentence is what indicates the payment has posted to the account; no other acknowledgement follows.
